title: SRD 5.1 importer: rule-text parser
description:
**Prerequisites (apply to all SRD 5.1 importer child issues):**
- Vendored SRD 5.1 PDF must be in place at `packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf` — see that directory's README.md.
- Reference implementation: mirror the structure of `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseSpells.ts` (parser), `emit.ts` (record builder + manifest description), `index.ts` (pipeline wiring), and the test layout under `packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/`.
- Depends on `loreweaver-0m9.5.9` (section detection + orchestrator) — receive a narrowed slice of the SRD core-rules chapters.

---

Add a parser for general rule-text sections in the SRD 5.1 (kind=rule). Each labeled rule section (e.g. "Advantage and Disadvantage", "Cover", "Resting", "Underwater Combat") becomes one record. The `rule` kindSchema requires a non-empty `text` field; capture the full rule body there. `key` should be `rule:<slug>`.

Split from the original 0m9.5.7 to keep ticket scope shippable in one session.
acceptance_criteria:
- Parser extracts each labeled rule section from the SRD core-rules chapters as a kind=rule record.
- Records satisfy dnd5e-srd rule kindSchema (data.text required).
- Manifest description includes 'rule' in Included record kinds.
- Unit tests cover representative rule sections of varying length (short like 'Cover', longer like 'Resting').
close_reason: Implemented SRD 5.1 rule-text parser (parseRules), coreRules section anchoring, emitter/orchestrator wiring for kind=rule records and manifest kinds; verification passed (importer tests + typecheck + biome check).
